content.short: HelloMoon provides information on Solana DeFi and NFT analytics.
content.description: HelloMoon is a human-readable index of the Solana ecosystem that helps users discover and compare NFT collections, DeFi tokens, and on-chain protocols. By connecting a wallet, users can access and monitor their portfolio directly on the site and track holdings across categories. Developers can use the API to pull on-chain activity data for integration, analytics, or tooling. HelloMoon also labels wallets actively engaging in each ecosystem, offering insight into participation and activity trends.
